title: ISMIP7 Submission: University of Alaska Fairbanks PISM
description: Ice-sheet model output submitted to ISMIP7 by the University of Alaska Fairbanks (UAF), run with the Parallel Ice Sheet Model (PISM). [domains and experiments — from the team]. Use the data/ prefix: it mirrors the submission as held in the ISMIP7 GHub collection at the University at Buffalo, which remains the archive of record and where the ISMIP7 compliance checks are applied. The submitted/ prefix is the modelling group's upload inbox and may hold files that have not yet been checked.
